messages:
maya: Heads-up: scheduled maintenance tonight 01:00-02:00 UTC. We'll soft-drain two racks in eu-west3 (r-41, r-42) for NIC firmware + BMC fence validation. Expect ~12% GPU capacity hit for ~40m while warm-backfill ramps. Plan attached in the ticket. Please ack and call out blockers.

raj: Ack. Which tenant groups get priority backfill?

maya: Priority order: prod-critical -> analytics -> sandbox. Prod-critical will be pinned to burst-standby pool during window. KV-cache will be pre-seeded to minimize tail latency.

alex: Can we slide start to 01:00? a customer batch job finishes ~00:45, would rather not overlap with that. :thinking_face:

maya: 01:00 works — shifted to 01:00 in ticket. Thanks for flagging.

sre-lead: I'll run a canary at T+0: cordon r-41, drain 2 low-util nodes, monitor tail latency & error-rate for 15m before continuing. If metrics look good we proceed to r-42 with staggered handoff (10m gap).

julie: Heads-up on cost: using burst-standby for backfill estimated ~$250/hr. For ~40m with two racks we project ~ $166 additional billed this window. I'll add billing tag "urgent-maint-2026-03".

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: MID-202603-438. Notifying @sre-oncall and scheduled status post at start time.

sre-oncall: Oncall here. I will shadow the canary and can trigger rollback. Agreement: abort if >3% absolute increase in 5m error-rate or sustained tail latency rise >40%.

maya: Rollback steps (scripted):
```bash
./infra playbook rollback --ticket MID-202603-438 --scope racks r-41,r-42
```
This uncordons nodes and halts firmware job.

raj: Any egress limits or billing windows we should be aware of? EU egress budget flagged in last review.

maya: Good call. We'll throttle non-critical telemetry and enable egress qcap for background flows during the window. No customer-facing bandwidth changes expected.

alex: Please add a short note to status page: "temporary capacity reduction in eu-west3; no expected downtime."

julie: I'll publish the status blurb and attach billing tag. Also tagging finance:costs for visibility.

sre-lead: Pre-start checklist I'll run T-30m:
- confirm canary traffic injection
- validate KV cache hit rate > 70%
- confirm autoscaler backfill reacts < 8m
- sanity poll tail latency across p50/p95/p99

maya: Canary scheduled at 01:00 UTC. Full rollout proceeds after 20m of stable canary metrics. @sre-oncall please confirm readiness at T-10m.

sre-oncall: Ready. I'll post a readiness ack at T-10 and be on-call for the window.

ops-bot: Reminder queued: MID-202603-438 will start 01:00 UTC. Status page will be posted at start.

raj: ACK. Did we send tenant notices?

maya: Sent targeted advance notices to three tenants ~2h ago. Final reminder scheduled 30m prior.

alex: I moved the affected cron for my customer to 02:00 — thanks for accommodating.

sre-lead: After a healthy canary we'll stagger r-42 drain and keep 10m reserved headroom during each handoff to avoid overlap-induced pressure.

maya: Thanks everyone. We'll post an outcome summary in this thread after the maintenance.
